corrections.reason: The Ge'ez conjunction ወ- at the end of line 7 is prefixed directly to የዓቅቦ on line 8, forming a single word across the line break.
Faded top arch on ብ caused it to be misread as ዝ; the commentary quotes the Ge'ez phrase ብፁዓት አጥባት ('blessed are the breasts').
The numeral ፴ (30) was misread as ፳ (20); the cross-reference for 'An evil generation seeks for a sign' is Matthew 12:39 (ማቴ ፲፪ ፴፱).

corrections.reason: The biblical cross-references for the Queen of the South (Sheba) are 3 Kingdoms (1 Kings) 10:1 (፫ነገ ፲ ፩) and 2 Chronicles 9:1 (፪ ዜና ፱ ፩); ink bleed caused ዜና ፱ to be misread as ኅፅ ፫.
The cross-reference for the men of Nineveh repenting at the preaching of Jonah is Jonah 3:5 (ዮና ፫ ፭), where ና was misread as ሐ.
